calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: «فارموں» bare in running text, or «زرعی فارموں» (N5's label form)?
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. N5's qualifier «زرعی» is owed where «فارم» stands UNQUALIFIED as a label or a list item, as in nav.leisure «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم», where two readers read the bare word as the form one fills in. It is not owed where a possessive or an attribute already qualifies the word, because that context fixes the sense. Here «فارموں» is qualified by «نخلستان کے» («نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں»), so the bare oblique stands. This is the ground of the approved texts too: «زکی السالم کا فارم», «اسٹرابیری کا فارم», and «… کاشت کرنے والے سب سے بڑے فارموں» on zaki-alsalem-farm. The kind of string (lead, meta description, heading) does not decide it. A string ruled a meta description under N184 is not, by that alone, owed the qualifier. This agrees with N5 and changes none of its forms. ‖ AMENDED IN b13-ui (judge round 1): the nav.leisure it quotes is the value since b13-ui (OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (N119 reversed; DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15», «Batch b13-ui»)); the reasoning and forms of the ruling are unchanged.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader: «زرعی» before «فارم» where the word stands unqualified as a label or a list item (N5: nav.leisure «بازار، پارک اور زرعی فارم», the farm category label «زرعی فارم»). It is not required where a possessive or an attribute qualifies it («… کا فارم», «نخلستان کے … فارموں», «… والے … فارموں»). A bare «فارم» as a label or list item is a finding; a qualified one is not.
calibration_rulings.ruled_by: Judge round2, b12-ui (round 4), 2026-10-15; record corrected by the judge's addendum to that round; quotation amended by the b13-ui judge, round 1, 2026-10-15

calibration_rulings.title: Does a NATIONAL PARK take the loan on /ur/ — «نیشنل پارک» — or the native wording of ruling N69 that stands in the title, «الاحساء کی قومی تفریح گاہ»?
calibration_rulings.binds: Every /ur/ string that names a park: done for the interface in b13-ui; national-park::title, ::body and the park pages in b14/b15.
calibration_rulings.ruling: THE WORDING, kept for the text until the owner answers: A, «الاحساء کی قومی تفریح گاہ», by ruling N69 and item N101; a batch judge reopens neither, and the owner's rule on loans (P16) is his. THE NAME OF THE THING is the OWNER'S DECISION: does a national park take the loan on /ur/? If yes: B, «الاحساء نیشنل پارک» (the reference's order; no possessive in the compound, as ruling N85 builds a compound title), in the title and where the body's first sentence names the park by its title, with the agreeing verb there following the gender the dictionary gives the loan; a termbase entry citing P16 and this evidence; and a proof pass and a blind read of the page. The body's other mentions of a park («ایک عوامی تفریح گاہ», «اس تفریح گاہ») keep ruling N69's noun. C is on record. THE JUDGE'S RECOMMENDATION: B for the national park alone — all three conditions of the test are met, and two readers of two missed what the place is from its title. Whether a park as such takes the loan is a wider question that ruling N69 answers today, and this item does not touch it. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-14) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN. The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 3): N119 (NEW): does a national park take the loan, «الاحساء نیشنل پارک»? Two readers of two did not recognise the place from its title; the judge recommends yes, for the national park alone. ‖ OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-14: the native title stands: «الاحساء کی قومی تفریح گاہ»; no loan «نیشنل پارک». The "if yes" of this entry does not apply. ‖ OWNER REVERSED 2026-10-15: the loan «پارک» for 'park' everywhere in /ur/, replacing «تفریح گاہ»; the answer of 2026-10-14 above ('the native title stands') is withdrawn, and with it the park generic of N69, N101 and N121 where it is «تفریح گاہ» (a garden stays «باغ»; the resort of N69 is not a park and is for the judge who meets it). «پارک» is masculine (its own entry): every agreeing verb and adjective follows. Done in the interface in b13-ui (nav.leisure, list2.title, crumb.leisure, det.allLeisure, CATEGORY_LABELS.parks). national-park's title and body, and every park page's titles, bodies and cards, are worded through the line in b14/b15 (N195). What the owner admitted is the noun «پارک»; the adjective stays «قومی» unless the b14/b15 judge admits «نیشنل» under P16-test. ‖ ROUND 2 (proof on r1, item 9): the rulings that still name «تفریح گاہ» as the park generic in their text or guard (N65, N69, N85, N101, N102, N103, N112, N117, N121, N122, N124, P3a) are withdrawn on that point by this entry and are amended by the b14/b15 judges where they reword the park pages; the guards of this file bind interface batches only.

calibration_rulings.ruling: C: CATEGORY_LABELS.ur.farm = «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» (written by the coordinator; in the worktree since round 1). SCOPE OF N5, quoted exactly: N5 binds 'nav.leisure; the category label of the farm group …' — THIS label — and refuses «باغات» as the word for the GROUP of farms ('the label's three groups would read as two'). C stays inside N5: the group is still named by its farm word, «زرعی فارم», first in the label; «کھجور کے باغات» renders the source's 'palms' («النخيل») by N5's own clause, 'an orchard or a palm grove is «باغ / باغات»', and by the entry «باغ» ('«کھجور کے باغات» stays the rendering of palm groves'; ur.wikipedia 25 pages, HTTP 200). EVIDENCE: the first reader found «کھجور کے درخت» odd as a category and expected «کھجور کے باغات» (round 1 item 6); the second read C as meant, 'farms and date-palm gardens', and objected only to the zoo and the bird garden being filed under it (round 2 item 12, the source's category). COST: the label shares «باغات» with the parks label «تفریح گاہیں اور باغات» in the index filters, and on sawsan-gardens it stands above a title that also ends «… کے باغات» (proof note 6). The kicker of the three farm pages («مزرعة ونخيل», not rendered) keeps «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے درخت» — a farm and its palm trees — so one source pair has two renderings, recorded. The «فارم» entry carries the same line (termbase_final); on apply N5 takes it too. ‖ ROUND 3: Unchanged; the third reader read the label as meant and objected only to the zoo and the bird garden under it (items 27, 32: the source's filing). THE QUALIFIED FORM «زرعی فارم» HAS NOW BEEN READ IN PLACE by three b10 readers (on-05 in A, on-r1 and on-r2 in C), none of whom read «فارم» as a form to fill in. LINE DRAFTED FOR N5 (for the coordinator's ap-meta, with this item as its authority): 'AMENDED IN b10 (item N161): the category label of the farm group is «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات» — the group named by «زرعی فارم»; «باغات» stands there only qualified, «کھجور کے باغات», rendering the source's 'palms' by this ruling's own palm-grove clause; it is not the group's word, which stays refused. The qualified form has been read in place by three blind readers without a remark on «فارم».' ‖ SUPERSEDED IN PART (b13-ui, judge round 2): by the owner's decision of 2026-10-15 ('Farms' alone) and #175 the farm label is «زرعی فارم» — the group's farm word, which this ruling put first, now stands alone; «کھجور کے باغات» left with the source's 'palms'. The parks label it quotes in its COST is «پارک اور باغات» since b13-ui (N119 as amended). «باغات» is still never the farm group's word.

calibration_rulings.title: When may an English loan enter, where the owner's rule (no loan where a common Urdu equivalent exists) meets a function that Urdu interfaces name with the loan?
calibration_rulings.binds: Every later interface batch and page: the test, and the two lists.
calibration_rulings.ruling: The owner's rule stands as written. A loan is admitted only when all three hold: (1) the native wording is shown not to be what the function or thing is called — by the localized interfaces or the press, not by taste; (2) a blind reader stumbled on it or was misled by it; (3) the loan has a dictionary headword or solid reference attestation. Each admission is a termbase entry that cites P16 with its evidence. Where the native word is common it stays, whatever the reader would have preferred. ADMITTED in this batch, final after three readings: «مینو», «لنک», «کاپی», «فارم» (in the bar label as «زرعی فارم»), «براؤزر» (pending: reference attestation only). REFUSED: «شیئر» (the function is «اشتراک کریں» on Android and Chrome; no dictionary entry; the native verb passed two readers), «لوکیشن» (the owner's banned list), «گائیڈ» (the owner's banned list), «فوٹوگرافی» (the owner's decision), «ہوٹل» (the native «رہائش» stands and passed the reader who saw it), «پروگرام» (a headword, but «راستہ» is the common word and nothing but taste is against it), «بلاگ» (no dictionary entry; «مضامین» passed all three readers), «ریستوراں» / «کیفے» («کھانے پینے کی جگہیں» passed all three), «بٹن» (not needed). The judge does not open the owner's lists; that all three readers write «گائیڈ», «لوکیشن» and «فوٹوگرافی» is recorded for him. ‖ RECORDED IN b13-ui (judge round 2), beside the list: «پارک» — admitted by the OWNER'S DECISION of 2026-10-15 for 'park' everywhere in /ur/ (P16 overridden for this word; its entry); «نمبر» — admitted on P16 itself (N193: no common native word for an item's number, Urdu Lughat headword), not on this test, whose condition (2) it does not meet.
calibration_rulings.guard: Proofreader, checklist item 9: the admitted loans are the termbase entries whose note cites P16; any other English loan in Urdu letters is reported. Stage checker: «شیئر» and «لوکیشن» join the banned list.
calibration_rulings.ruled_by: Round 1 judge, b0-ui round 3, 2026-10-12; list recorded by the b13-ui judge, round 2, 2026-10-15

calibration_rulings.title: det.unescoNo: the loan «نمبر» for 'no.' / «رقم».
calibration_rulings.binds: det.unescoNo; every later string that numbers an item.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «نمبر» is admitted on P16 itself (an English loan enters with a dictionary-cited entry, and only where no common Urdu word has the sense): «عدد» is a numeral, «شمارہ» a periodical's issue, and no common native word names an item's number; «نمبر» is a headword of Urdu Lughat with Urdu idioms (udb.gov.pk) and the ordinary word in reference usage (ur.wikipedia «ٹیلی فون نمبر», «گاڑی نمبر پلیٹ»). P16-test, made for a function the interfaces name with a loan, is not its ground: its condition (2) is not met and is not claimed. Two readers read it in place without a stumble on the word; that is recorded, and sets no precedent for admitting a loan a reader passes. Entry verified (termbase_final). Masculine; plural «نمبر», oblique «نمبروں». B misleads; C drops the source's 'no.'. (Round 1 said 'all three conditions met': corrected here.)
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read: «نمبر» follows the noun it numbers («حصہ نمبر {n}»); «شمارہ» is not used for an item's number.
